introHtml: Custom rainbow kitchen utensils bring a bold, cheerful look to any company kitchen or event giveaway. Unlike standard solid-color tools, the rainbow finish adds a playful, inclusive feel that works especially well for Pride month promotions or diversity-themed campaigns. These durable utensils are made from high-quality nylon or stainless steel with heat-resistant handles, and they accept full-color imprinting on the handles or shafts. Whether you are outfitting a breakroom or assembling gift bags for a company picnic, rainbow utensils stand out on any table.
